shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a rectangular surface
figures arranged in a horizontal row/register
schematic anthropomorphic-like figure with raised arms
head shown in profile with prominent snout/beak
justification: Both surfaces present a horizontal frieze of relief figures with prominent snouted/beaked profile heads, quadruped or crouching bodies and conspicuously raised, splayed arms or forelimbs, rendered in a comparably schematic low relief with strong outline and little internal detail. However, A stacks several distinct registers including an upper row of animal-headed blocks, a band of hatched/geometric pattern and isolated animals (bird, snake-like curves), whereas B shows a single continuous row of similar figures apparently linked or reaching toward one another along an upper edge, without any geometric band or multi-tier composition.
